clue.text: Pleased most of fireplace has variety of fuel

indicators.note: most of means the word for the fireplace loses its final letter

parts.note: a grate is the metal frame of a fireplace

indicators.note: a variety of something is a different form of it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is happy that much of the hearth burns a mix of fuels.
explanation.definitionFit: Being grateful means feeling thankful, close to pleased or glad about something received.

clue.text: Someone retreating right ahead of artilleryman — not good

indicators.note: ahead of puts the right abbreviation before the next piece
not tells us the letter for good is removed from the soldier

parts.note: a gunner is a soldier in the artillery

explanation.surface: A soldier flees from the guns, showing poor conduct.
explanation.definitionFit: To do a runner is British slang for fleeing, so a runner is a person who runs away.

clue.text: Story-teller in bar getting upset

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the word for bar is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a rail is a bar, as in a towel rail

explanation.surface: A raconteur in a pub becomes upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' suggests a pub, but here it is a rod.
explanation.definitionFit: A fibber tells stories in the sense of falsehoods, so a story-teller can be one who lies.

clue.text: Count bridge team in church with us

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
North and South form a partnership in the card game bridge
taken as written

explanation.surface: Tallying a card-playing team in church along with ourselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'with' only link the pieces, which sit side by side in clue order.
explanation.definitionFit: A census is an official count of a population.

clue.text: Plan great changes in farm building

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged letters inside the pig shelter

parts.note: a sty is where pigs are kept on a farm

indicators.note: changes says the letters of great are altered in order

explanation.surface: A scheme for big alterations to a barn.
explanation.definitionFit: A strategy is a long-term plan of action toward a goal.

clue.text: University best, excellent, rising — an ideal place

parts.note: top means best, as in top marks

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: A1 means excellent, written here as AI

explanation.surface: A top university climbing the rankings is an ideal place.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (first-class) is taken as the letters A and I, and 'rising' turns them round to IA.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas More's imaginary perfect island gave its name to any perfect society.

clue.text: Singer displaying some ethereal tones

indicators.note: displaying some says part of the following words is on show, a run of letters hidden inside them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A vocalist produces airy, otherworldly notes.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Singer displaying' as the definition, but 'displaying' belongs with 'some' as the hiding signal; the definition is just 'Singer'.
explanation.definitionFit: An alto sings the low female or high male voice part in a choir.

clue.text: Normal behaviour in occupying road

indicators.note: occupying means the word in sits inside the road

parts.note: a route is a road or way
taken as written

explanation.surface: Ordinary conduct while taking over a street.
explanation.definitionFit: A routine is a habitual, regular course of action.

clue.text: Closed discussion? Not quite complete

parts.note: a door that is to is shut

indicators.note: not quite means the word for discussion loses its final letter

parts.note: talk means discussion

explanation.surface: A meeting held behind closed doors that did not quite finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Total as an adjective means absolute or entire.

clue.text: Singer's meaning heard

definitions.meaning: a male voice higher than baritone
the general sense or drift of what is said

explanation.surface: A vocalist's message comes across.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenor is the high male voice, and the tenor of a speech is its gist.

clue.text: Bathroom purchase fake? Not entirely dreadful

parts.note: a sham is a fake

indicators.note: not entirely means the word for dreadful loses its last letter

parts.note: poor means dreadful, of low quality

explanation.surface: Something bought for the bathroom turns out fake, though not wholly terrible.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair wash is a typical item bought to keep in the bathroom.

clue.text: Early indication favouring redistribution of estate

parts.note: for means in favour of

indicators.note: redistribution means the letters of estate are shared out in a new order

explanation.surface: An early sign of support for sharing out property.
explanation.definitionFit: A foretaste is a sample of what is to come.

clue.text: Be slow to grasp new question without agitation

indicators.note: to grasp means to hold the following letters inside

parts.note: to trail is to lag behind

explanation.surface: Being slow to understand a fresh question, but calmly.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm and untroubled, free from agitation.

clue.text: No source of money remains

indicators.note: no source of means the money word loses its first letter, its source

parts.note: cash is money

explanation.surface: With no income, nothing is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Ash is the residue left after burning, and remains can mean cremated ashes.

clue.text: Line of plants in border region initially brought into question

indicators.note: brought into means the pieces are put inside the question word

parts.note: how is a question word
an edge is a border

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of region

explanation.surface: A frontier region's status is first called into question.
explanation.definitionFit: A hedgerow is a row of shrubs and bushes forming a field boundary.

clue.text: Prisoner left with silver

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A convict leaves holding silver loot.
explanation.definitionFit: Old lag is British slang for a convict, especially a habitual one.

clue.text: Dressing without top of nightie? That's tawdry

indicators.note: without means the following letter is taken out

parts.note: a garnish is a dressing for food

indicators.note: in a down clue the top of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Getting dressed with no nightie on top looks cheap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dressing' suggests clothing, which the nightie supports, but it is food decoration.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something showy and vulgar.

clue.text: Church staff restricting a haunt of Beatles fans?

indicators.note: restricting means the staff word holds the letter inside

parts.note: a rod is a staff or stick

explanation.surface: Church employees limiting one place where fans of a band gather.
explanation.walkthrough: Abbey Road is the London street of the Beatles' recording studio and album cover crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous zebra crossing there draws Beatles fans, making it their haunt.

clue.text: Baster ruined serving of chicken

indicators.note: ruined means the letters of the word are wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: A broken basting tool spoils the chicken dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Breast meat is a cut served from a roast chicken.

clue.text: Difficult situation of French in language exam

indicators.note: in puts the French word inside the exam

parts.note: an oral is a spoken exam in a language
de is French for of

explanation.surface: A tough moment in a French speaking test.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a painful or trying experience.

clue.text: Flamboyant Queen embraced by graduate and libertine

parts.note: BA is a Bachelor of Arts

indicators.note: embraced by means the queen letter is held inside the rake

parts.note: a roué is a dissolute man

explanation.definitionFit: Baroque describes an ornate, extravagant style of art and music.

clue.text: Heads for Baltic after some Scandinavian fish

explanation.surface: Fish swim to the Baltic after some Scandinavian waters.

clue.text: Somewhere to write about Minister

parts.note: a pad is a writing block
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A writing spot about a clergyman.

clue.text: Piano that is swamping another piano and organ part

parts.note: i.e. is short for id est, that is
a second p for piano

clue.text: Quiet one eating American and Japanese food

clue.text: Singer in small musical work hurried over

ran means hurried
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A vocalist rushed through a little piece.
